pin_regs.reason: OWNER RULE 19:50: the RTL already registers every data pin -- xd on xf and xd2 on xf2 (ot_s81_static_column_ingress pin register), ri/st on cr (rr/sti), every output from a flop (xa/xb/cc/x2 *_r, rd = rr/rsync, rs = rsync); co = ck and rf = cr are clock wires. A flow pin register would add an edge the die calendar does not price.

structural_change: First hardening of the die's STATIC x2-pair column entry dsfd_cfifo (128 die instances; VIS-ROM S81F-02 SEV1): the die (c21h, --bf-x2-static --bf-x2-pair --cfifo-colck) binds xd2[537:0]/xf2 on every instance but the bound elements.lef view (legacy meso-FIFO cfifo, 431.976x95.016) has no such pins -> 68,864 die bits unconnected. RTL = the c21h glue module (sha256 e892a5bb) with the eight 1-bit ports declared scalar (same width/connectivity); two ot_s81_static_column_ingress (xd on xf, xd2 on xf2; fixed epoch, no ready/credit/occupancy), outputs registered on cr. Three CTS roots (cr core / xf / xf2 lanes, related same-frequency phase 0). Pins (tools/s81/cfifo_x2pair_pins.py): x2 at the station x2i pitch 0.096 under the sinf station column (die jog 25.68 -> 0), cc/st under cci/so (jog 53 -> 0), xd2/xf2 new on S beside xd, xf beside xd, rd 0.096 pitch, cr at the core-sink centroid; outline 431.976x95.016 -> 280.8x51.84 keeping the absolute die x/y of the N-face data pins (slot change). 0 cycles vs the die glue.
